what: Retrieve Committee Data from the Austrian Parliament API — get_committees
title: Retrieve Committee Data from the Austrian Parliament API — get_committees
text: Get data committeses Austrian Parliament. Data includes session dates, agendas, meeting overviews, member lists. function mirrors search functionality Austrian Parliament's website committees .

title: Retrieve Committee Data from the Austrian Parliament API — get_committees
code: get_committees(   search_string = NULL,   institution = NULL,   legis_period = NULL,   permanent = NULL,   include_subcommittees = NULL,   echo = NULL )

title: Retrieve Committee Data from the Austrian Parliament API — get_committees
text: search_string character string free text search within committee records. Optional. institution character string specifying institution ("Bundesrat" "Nationalrat"). parameter mandatory internally encoded "BR" "NR" respectively. legis_period character vector representing one legislative period codes. element validated using internal helper function. permanent logical flag indicating whether permanent committees queried. set TRUE, corresponding API parameter adjusted accordingly. Optional. include_subcommittees logical flag indicate whether subcommittees included search results. Note permanent TRUE, subcommittee search disallowed. echo Logical. TRUE, function prints used search parametes url pertaining search results website Austrian Parlament.

title: Get Event Data from Parlament API — get_events
text: search_string Optional character string used filter search results. institution Character specifying institution query. Must one "Bundesrat" "Nationalrat". event_type Optional character string indicating event type. See Details. place Optional character string filter events location. See details. date_start Optional character string representing start date "dd-mm-yyyy" format. date_end Optional character string representing end date "dd-mm-yyyy" format. echo Logical indicating; prints used search parameters, number hits, link results website parliament.

title: Get Event Data from Parlament API — get_events
text: data frame containing event details results found. events match criteria, function prints message returns NULL.

title: Get Event Data from Parlament API — get_events
text: Allowed event types : "Plenarsitzung (Plenary Session)" "Ausschusssitzung oder Ausschuss (Committee Meeting Committee)" "Besuch einer Plenarsitzung (Visit Plenary Session)" "Demokratiebildung (Democracy Education)" "Fest-/Gedenksitzung (Ceremonial/Commemorative Session)" "Führung (Guided Tour)" "Internationales (International)" "Klubveranstaltung (Club Event)" "Konferenz (Conference)" "Parlamentarische Enquete (Parliamentary Inquiry)" "Pressekonferenz (Press Conference)" "Sitzung der Bundesversammlung (Federal Assembly Session)" "Sonstiger Termin (Event)" "Veranstaltung (Event)".

text: Must match one predefined choices.

title: Get Event Data from Parlament API — get_events

title: Search for Parliamentary Items — get_items
text: get_items searches items ('Verhandlungsgegenstände') subject negotiations Austrian National Council ('Nationalrat') Federal Council ('Bundesrat'). function mirrors search functionality offered Austrian Parliament's website. See .

title: Search for Parliamentary Items — get_items
code: get_items(   search_string = NULL,   topic = NULL,   institution = "Nationalrat",   legis_period = NULL,   date_start = NULL,   date_end = NULL,   item = NULL,   doc_type = NULL,   person = NULL,   number = NULL,   keyword = NULL,   eurovoc = NULL,   parl_group = NULL,   parl_group_names_standard = FALSE,   echo = TRUE )

title: Search for Parliamentary Items — get_items
text: topic Character vector NULL. Specifies topic(s) search . See 'Details' possible values. Default NULL. institution Character string. Either "Nationalrat" (National Council) "Bundesrat" (Federal Council). Default "Nationalrat". legis_period Character vector NULL. Specifies legislative period(s) search . See 'Details' possible values. Default NULL. date_start Character string. Start date search period format "dd-mm-yyyy". Default NULL. date_end Character string. End date search period format "dd-mm-yyyy". Default NULL. item Character vector NULL. Specifies type(s) parliamentary item(s) search . See 'Details' possible values. Default NULL. doc_type Character vector NULL. Specifies type parliamentary item(s) search . See 'Details' possible values. Default NULL. person Character string NULL. Name person search (family name, optionally followed first name). Default NULL. number Character string NULL. Specific item number search . Default NULL. keyword Character vector NULL. Keyword(s) search . Default NULL. eurovoc Character vector NULL. EuroVoc term(s) search . Default NULL. parl_group Character vector NULL. Parliamentary group(s) search . Default NULL. Combine multiple groups vector, .e. c("SPÖ", "ÖVP"). See 'Details.' parl_group_names_standard Logical. TRUE, function expands standardizes parliamentary group names. Default FALSE. See 'Details.' echo Logical. TRUE, function prints used search parametes url  pertaining search results website Austrian Parlament.
